messages:
Nina: Heads-up: Pearl Labs just triggered a nightly embed surge, billing flagged it. Need a concise QBR-friendly summary for renewals.
Raj: on it. looks like an ingestion job retried 4x between 01:00-01:12 UTC. pulling logs and env split.
Mei: customer note in support: 'this burn is unexpected, can we cap it?' Mark renewal watch.
Carlos: for the QBR we should show two scenarios: baseline and mitigated (batching + cache + small throttle). Keep slide < 1 pager.
Nina: action list: 1) Raj -> env/day burn table (24h, 7d); 2) Carlos -> mitigation assumptions + one-liner commands; 3) Mei -> outreach template + renewal risk flag.
Raj: quick prelim numbers:
```
24h tokens: 3.6M
7d tokens: 15.9M
30d proj (current): 68M
```
Carlos: estimated mitigation: batching + KV prefix cache -> ~28% token drop -> 30d ~49M. I'll add expected latency delta and simple SDK snippet.
billing-bot: Alert: account=pearl-labs, threshold=spend_spike, time=2026-02-15T01:18:00Z
Mei: propose we set a soft budget alert at 60% monthly and an auto-notify to CS + SE. If customer wants, offer a paid burst cushion to smooth retention risk.
Nina: I'll draft the QBR slide: TL;DR burn numbers, mitigation path, recommended ask (burst cushion + enablement).
Raj: dropping env chart and command snippet into the shared deck now.
Carlos: I'll include a two-line playbook to toggle batching and a one-click runbook link for the customer.
Mei: outreach template is drafted: short, action-first, offer 30-min enablement session.
Nina: schedule a quick rehearsal 09:00 tomorrow to finalize wording and dollars.
Raj: :+1:
Mei: :thumbsup:
Carlos: :rocket:
